newsitem.title: USA: Public Service to return $20 million.
newsitem.headline: Public Service to return $20 million.

text.p: Public Service Co of Colorado said Tuesday that natural gas customers will receive as much as $500 million in refunds following a U.S. Supreme Court decision earlier this week.

The company, which estimated its share of the refund at $20 million, said the Court upheld an August 1996 ruling that said Kansas property taxes were unlawfully collected by producers as part of the price of gas sold to interstate pipelines.
It said the refund covers the period from 1983 to 1988, when the tax was collected.

It said much of the natural gas supplied to Colorado from the period came from Kansas, and as a result Colorado consumers will be entitled to refunds from natural gas utilities that were sales customers of the pipeline companies.
The company said its share of the award will be about $20 million and that the remainder of the sum will benefit customers of other buyers of Kansas natural gas.
